selected_evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm mounted with noexec,nosuid,nodev, persisted via fstab
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed /tmp not separately mounted and /dev/shm lacking noexec; added fstab tmpfs entries with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev for both, applied live via daemon-reload/remount/mount, and findmnt confirmed both options active

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof that execution is blocked on /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Attempted to execute chmod +x scripts placed in /tmp and /dev/shm; both denied with exit code 126 before and after reboot
Captured pre-restart boot_id (5fb1b173-...) and systemctl is-system-running=running

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed systemctl reboot command returned 'reboot_scheduled' acknowledgement immediately, then subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection resets until exec succeeded again; boot_id changed from 5fb1b173-... to 4000662d-f97a-45f9-8a00-178d5d4be10f, proving a genuine reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state: mounts persisted and system healthy after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart findmnt confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm still tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev and tmp.mount active; systemctl is-system-running=running; functional noexec test repeated successfully
